summary: Enhance your skills with our comprehensive Social Research Methods Training. Learn effective techniques to conduct impactful research and analyze data.
lede: Social research methods help professionals turn a social issue into a study with clear questions, suitable evidence, and documented conclusions. Designed for people who plan, conduct, analyze, or use research, the course covers choosing a research design, building a sampling and recruitment plan, and developing survey or interview tools. It also introduces data organization, basic analysis, ethical handling, and reporting findings with transparent limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, commission, conduct, analyze, or use social research and need a reliable foundation for practical study delivery.
prerequisites: No degree in social science or programming experience is required. You should have a practical interest in collecting or using evidence about people, communities, customers, employees, or programme beneficiaries. Basic spreadsheet skills and access to a research problem are helpful. Coding is not required for completion. R, NVivo, and Qualtrics activities use guided examples, provided datasets, or comparable organizational tools, so you will not need to build software or deploy statistical models.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
